style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. Early 1900s period details.
avoid_en: logos or emblems of real companies or government agencies, readable text or numbers, banknote designs, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people

morgan.desc_en: the old banker, a heavyset elderly man figurine around seventy with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), a thick white mustache shape, a tall black silk top hat, a long black frock coat, a gray waistcoat with a thin gold watch chain, holding a black cane

bankers.desc_en: banker figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), early 1900s plain gray three-piece suits, black bowler hats or bare short hair, no badges or text

president.desc_en: the president, a large stout middle-aged man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), a thick brown walrus mustache shape, receding hair, a plain dark 1890s suit

president2.desc_en: the later president, a sturdy middle-aged man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), small round spectacles, a short brown mustache shape, a plain dark 1900s suit

cuts.en: Close-up of the closed heavy wooden library door; in front of it the old banker figurine slips a small red key into his coat pocket. The key is the only bright red object. Dramatic lamplight.

cuts.image: 書斎の机の上で、スーツの男のフィギュアが、無地の書類に赤いペンで署名している（文字は読めない）
cuts.image_en: On a library desk at dawn, a banker figurine signs a plain blank document with a red fountain pen; other figurines watch. Blue early light through the window.
cuts.en: On a library desk at dawn, a banker figurine signs a plain blank document with a red fountain pen; other figurines watch. Blue early light through the window.

cuts.image: 書斎の扉が大きく開き、外から朝の青白い光が差しこむ
cuts.image_en: The heavy library double doors swung wide open, pale blue dawn light pouring in, banker figurines walking out slowly. White space beyond.
cuts.en: The heavy library double doors swung wide open, pale blue dawn light pouring in, banker figurines walking out slowly. White space beyond.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、大きな製鉄所の模型が、小さな製鉄所の模型を口のように開いて飲みこもうとしている
cuts.image_en: A huge steel mill model looming over a much smaller steel mill model in the white space, the big one's gate opening like a mouth to swallow the small one. Symbolic.
cuts.en: A huge steel mill model looming over a much smaller steel mill model in the white space, the big one's gate opening like a mouth to swallow the small one. Symbolic.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、メガネと口ひげのがっしりした男のフィギュアが、机の書類に判を押している（文字は読めない）
cuts.image_en: the second president figurine at a big desk pressing a stamp onto a plain blank document, morning light, in the white space.
cuts.en: the second president figurine at a big desk pressing a stamp onto a plain blank document, morning light, in the white space.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、議会の建物の模型。丸い屋根の下に、小さな人のフィギュアが集まっている（旗は無い）
cuts.image_en: A miniature domed capitol-style legislative building in the white space, small figurines gathering on its wide steps. No flags, no text. Calm daylight.
cuts.en: A miniature domed capitol-style legislative building in the white space, small figurines gathering on its wide steps. No flags, no text. Calm daylight.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、シルクハットの老人のフィギュアが、杖に体を預けて、窓の外を見ている
cuts.image_en: the old banker figurine leaning heavily on his cane, looking out of a tall window, his back slightly bent, in a quiet library corner.
cuts.en: the old banker figurine leaning heavily on his cane, looking out of a tall window, his back slightly bent, in a quiet library corner.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、長い机に並んで座る、スーツの男のフィギュアたち。机の上に書類の山（文字は読めない）
cuts.image_en: A row of committee figurines in dark suits sitting at a long wooden table piled with blank papers, in the white space. Formal.
cuts.en: A row of committee figurines in dark suits sitting at a long wooden table piled with blank papers, in the white space. Formal.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、議会の聞き取りの部屋の模型。証人の席にシルクハットを置いた老人のフィギュア
cuts.image_en: A miniature hearing room diorama in the white space: the old banker figurine sits alone at the witness table with his top hat beside him, facing a raised bench of questioners.
cuts.en: A miniature hearing room diorama in the white space: the old banker figurine sits alone at the witness table with his top hat beside him, facing a raised bench of questioners.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、小さな会社の建物の模型がずらりと並び、それぞれから赤い糸が1か所に集まっている
cuts.image_en: Over a hundred tiny company building models arranged in rows in the white space, a red thread running from each one and all threads gathering to a single point in the center.
cuts.en: Over a hundred tiny company building models arranged in rows in the white space, a red thread running from each one and all threads gathering to a single point in the center.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、シルクハットの老人のフィギュアが、自分の胸に手を当てている
cuts.image_en: the old banker figurine placing one hand over his chest, standing straight, in a pool of warm light in the white space.
cuts.en: the old banker figurine placing one hand over his chest, standing straight, in a pool of warm light in the white space.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、ローマの古い石の街並みの模型。夕暮れの柔らかい光
cuts.image_en: A miniature diorama of old Roman stone buildings and a small piazza at dusk in the white space, warm fading light, empty streets.
cuts.en: A miniature diorama of old Roman stone buildings and a small piazza at dusk in the white space, warm fading light, empty streets.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、空っぽだった銀行の土台の上に、柱の並ぶ大きな建物が建っている
cuts.image_en: The same stone foundation from before, now with a grand columned bank building fully built on top of it, in the white space. Bright clean light. No signs.
cuts.en: The same stone foundation from before, now with a grand columned bank building fully built on top of it, in the white space. Bright clean light. No signs.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、今の銀行の支店の模型。入り口の前に、今の服装の人のフィギュアが数人並んでいる
cuts.image_en: A modern bank branch building model with glass doors in the white space; a few figurines in modern clothes stand in a short line at the entrance. No logos, no signs.
cuts.en: A modern bank branch building model with glass doors in the white space; a few figurines in modern clothes stand in a short line at the entrance. No logos, no signs.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、スマホの模型の画面から、金貨の模型が川のように流れ出ている（文字は無い）
cuts.image_en: A plain modern smartphone lying on the white floor; from its blank glowing screen, a stream of gold coins pours out and away. No text.
cuts.en: A plain modern smartphone lying on the white floor; from its blank glowing screen, a stream of gold coins pours out and away. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、ガラスの箱の模型。中に金貨の山が入っていて、箱に赤い南京錠がかかっている
cuts.image_en: A clear glass box model in the white space with a neat pile of gold coins inside, a red padlock on its lid. Calm protective light.
cuts.en: A clear glass box model in the white space with a neat pile of gold coins inside, a red padlock on its lid. Calm protective light.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、ガラスの箱からあふれた金貨が、箱の外にこぼれている
cuts.image_en: The same glass box model, but gold coins overflow its rim and spill onto the white floor outside the box. Slightly worrying mood.
cuts.en: The same glass box model, but gold coins overflow its rim and spill onto the white floor outside the box. Slightly worrying mood.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、今の服装の人のフィギュアが、通帳の形の無地の小さな冊子を開いて見つめている
cuts.image_en: A figurine in modern casual clothes standing in the white space, looking down at a small open blank booklet in its hands. Soft light.
cuts.en: A figurine in modern casual clothes standing in the white space, looking down at a small open blank booklet in its hands. Soft light.
